title: Pink Tie-Dye Cotton Halter Neck Kurta Palazzo Set with Grey Ombre Dupatta
color_custom: Pink with white tie-dye chevrons, grey palazzo & pink-grey ombre dupatta
description:
Gulaal means the pink colour of celebration – bright, happy and full of life, just like this set.

A cheerful pink cotton kurta, tie-dyed in soft white chevrons that run down like waves. The high halter neckline and sleeveless cut keep it fresh and modern, and the A-line shape flares gently to calf length. It comes with wide-leg grey cotton palazzo pants and a matching tie-dye dupatta that fades from pink into deep grey at both ends.

✦ The Details
• High halter neckline with a keyhole button opening at the back
• Sleeveless, A-line kurta with a soft flare, calf length
• All-over pink and white tie-dye chevrons
• Pocket in the kurta
• Wide-leg grey cotton palazzo pants
• Cotton dupatta in pink tie-dye with grey ombre ends

✦ Fabric & Craft
Soft, breathable cotton – easy to wear all day, even in warm weather. Tie-dye is made by tying the fabric before dyeing, so the white lines are never perfectly even. Every piece comes out a little different.

✦ Fit & Size
Relaxed, flowy fit. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Silver or pearl jhumkas and clear heels for a festive lunch or mehndi; flat kolhapuris and a tote for the office or a holiday. Wear the dupatta on both arms to show off the grey ombre ends.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

Every tie-dye piece is unique – the pattern and colour vary slightly from piece to piece, and that is part of its charm. The colour may also look slightly different on your screen.

care: Hand wash separately in cold water – tie-dye may bleed a little in the first few washes. Do not bleach or soak. Dry inside out in shade and iron on medium heat.
